gatoh.model.model.ABModel.update

ABModel.update() → None[source]

Updates the agents’ internal states to match the model step. This mainly handles the construction of agents’ perceived opinion climates within their hierarchies, and the simulation of opinion silencing behaviours depending on these climates.
